prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game VFX animation atlas. Create a hand-drawn anime cartoon electric beam for Magic Drink, NOT a geometric icon and NOT a uniform zigzag line. Exact layout 4 equal columns x 3 equal rows with generous transparent separation, no labels. Row 1: four successive frames of a horizontal electricity ribbon stretching left to right, organic tapering yellow-white core, blue ink contour, cyan branching forks, lively curved sharp flicks, irregular thick-and-thin brush silhouettes. Row 2: four successive frames of a larger charged discharge, turbulent yellow-white core with blue electric flame tongues and a broad spear tip to right, roughly 2x row1 thickness. Row3: four expanding then dissolving electric contact bursts, inked blue edges, yellow-white center, tiny magenta sparks. All cells centered. Beam rows each occupy 80% cell width and 35% cell height; no beam goes across a cell edge. Clean cel painted animation cels, same charming colorful anime cartoon aesthetic as hand drawn games, slightly variable ink thickness, rich shapes with minimal glow, crisp transparent alpha, no background no text no characters no checkerboard.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent VFX spritesheet for a hand-drawn cartoon magical pink ribbon whip. 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows. Row 1: 4 sequential fluid swoosh whips, each centered horizontal with the attachment point at left and tip curling at right. Real wide satin ribbon: pink front, burgundy underside visible at twisting folds, pale pink cel highlights, dark raspberry ink contour, taper to a forked ribbon tail, springy S-shaped curve. Four distinct phases flexing up then down, not laser lines or rope. Row2: four successive impact frames of a big ribbon bow snapping into curls then fading into loose pink confetti and little star sparkles. Cell boundaries transparent generous padding. Same colorful charming anime cartoon line art as Magic Drink. No text no background no characters no blur, true transparent background.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: new transparent sprite animation for Hexy in provided reference. Preserve exact character identity, face, bright pink long hair, navy witch hat with yellow star, white sailor top red bow blue skirt navy socks and black buckle shoes; gold star wand. Create NEW full-body animation sheet, 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows = eight consecutive poses of swinging her star wand like a ribbon whip, all facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Read left-right first row then second. Frame0 anticipation: weight back wand raised behind above head. Frame1 shoulder winds up. Frame2 forceful overhead swing forward. Frame3 wand sweeps forward at shoulder height. Frame4 extended forward with tilted torso. Frame5 follow-through down toward right knee. Frame6 wrist circles upward recovering. Frame7 upright ready wand extended right. Arm, wrist, shoulder, torso, hair and skirt must visibly animate; expressive determined face. Do not draw actual ribbon or effects (game overlays them). Feet baseline identical all eight cells; same body height, head size and scale, centered hips, full hat/boots/wand inside each cell with padding. No ground no shadows no labels. Crisp colorful cel painted anime cartoon matching reference. Transparent background.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact eight-frame sprite sheet: remove ALL background, colored halos and glows; transparent alpha outside the character silhouettes and wands. Preserve all eight drawings, exact colors and identity, ink edges, poses and clothes. Keep a perfectly regular 4-column x 2-row grid. Put both boot soles on the same baseline 92% down each cell and hips centered in each cell. Preserve the wand stars, black hat outlines, hair strands. No gradients or backlight outside the drawings, no cast shadows, no text. Actual transparent background is mandatory; not a black, white or checkerboard backdrop.
